module: Garage routes (Vue): overview, vehicle (selector, tuning and mirrors, paint, parts, configuration save), vehicle list, "mycars", photo mode and overlay editing. Root hook: gameplay_garageMode.onGarageEnter. Dynamic vehicle titles via gameplay_garageMode.vehicleByIdOrActive.
notes: Route configuration module: it exports no function. routeManager reads it (via the ui_router_routes_<name> extension) when routes.lua includes it with `{ include = "<name>" }`.
The keys of `Children` form the segments of the dotted name: "<module>.<child>". `children` (lowercase) in a node designates its sub-routes; `include` mounts another module there.
`ui` is inherited by child routes (uiTypes, uiTypesFilter, infoBar, topBar, uiApps, uiNav, triggerPause): a child redefines it only for what changes.
The vehicles/mycars routes use the same screenId "garage.vehicles"; their hooks are ui_vehicleSelector_general.onRootRoute* and ui_garage_routeLifecycleCallbacks.onPhotomode* for photo mode.

Root.desc: {screenId = "garage", title = "Garage", scopeTree garage-layout > garage-sidemenu, ui = Vue, infoBar visible without system info, topBar and uiApps hidden, onEnter = gameplay_garageMode.onGarageEnter}

Children.desc: vehicle (abstract; selector, tuning > mirrors, paint, parts, save), vehicles (> vehicle), mycars (> vehicle), photomode (exitGuards confirmPhotomodeExit; > overlay > edit > adjust).

ModuleName.desc: Name of the routes module (first segment of the dotted name).
